# 1436. Destination City

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def destCity(self, paths):
        """
        :type paths: List[List[str]]
        :rtype: str
        """
        set1 = set([])
        set2 = set([])
        for x, y in paths:
            set1.add(x)
            set1.add(y)
            set2.add(x)
        return list(set1 - set2)[0]
```
